'''''Scrophularia peregrina''''', the '''Mediterranean figwort''', is a species of annual herb in the family [[Scrophulariaceae]]. They have a self-supporting growth form. Individuals can grow to 0.39 m.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Scrophularia peregrina L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/392536|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Scrophularia peregrina (Nettle-leaved Figwort) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/SCRO/Scrophularia_peregrina.php |access-date=2022-03-07 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref>
